pos.personaBrief: Possession-based passing side built around Fabregas and the 'wonderful display of possession football' (Hard Tackle 2006/07); Wenger loves quick interchanges, though the 2011 Barcelona game showed a counter option.

pro.personaBrief: Short-passing midfield, Wenger's obsession with midfielders playing forward and Wilshere finding lanes; patient but forward-minded, not long-ball.

est.personaBrief: Fluid 4-4-1-1 with a revolving door behind the striker and Fabregas roaming freely; Wenger wants a current passing through the eleven.

lar.personaBrief: Combination play through the middle with Fabregas and central creators; wingers like Hleb and Ljungberg cut inside, though Bergkamp says wide players were told to play with freedom.

blo.personaBrief: High line and midfield pressing in 2010/11 (Bleacher Report), 'nothing to protect' attitude; deep defending not part of the identity.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal in open play with a high line, but corners were man-marked until the 2011 change (Arsenalinsider), with no star-shadowing evidence.

pla.personaBrief: Strong own identity imposed by Wenger ('they could play their natural game'), only small tweaks like the 4-5-1 at Old Trafford.

res.personaBrief: Spectacle first: 'we have nothing to protect, we want to score goals'; Wenger loves the quick interchange and happy football.

sis.personaBrief: Talent-centred: team built around Fabregas with freedom and licence to play instinctively; Wenger lenient on defensive duties of creators.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, passing team with a creative number 10, small players and admitted weakness in the air ('we don't have tall guys').

bas.personaBrief: Wenger: 'builder more than investor', team of young players and a pact with them; youth over experience, even as a title bid.

lid.personaBrief: Paternal, people-first manager (pact with the young, kept Flamini); negotiates and trusts rather than punishing with an iron fist.
